Support compliance with social insurance, labor office, and other employment-related governmental requirements. Maintain appropriate documentation to minimize employment-related legal and regulatory risks. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage recruitment processes for technical, administrative, and business positions. Draft and publish job advertisements and screening criteria. Support workforce planning and recruitment forecasting with management. HR Operations & Development Identify opportunities to improve and automate HR processes. Strong understanding of personnel administration, social insurance, and labor-office requirements in Egypt. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
